name: stale-autoverify-promotion
description: Does the stale-turn auto-verify (BANTAM_AUTOVERIFY_STALE_TURNS) regress baseline reliability? Candidate=on(8) vs reference=off(0). Its targeted benefit was measured separately on swb3-migreduce (first-done 35.3->25.0 turns); this experiment is the no-regression gate for promotion.
